label: PF Backlog 205
title: Backend: adopt MCP - expose our tools as MCP servers + consume external MCP tools
body:
## Problem / why
Our tools are internal (core/tool_policy). The ecosystem standard for agent<->tool is MCP.
## Goal
Expose our tools via an MCP endpoint and let agents consume external MCP servers.
## Acceptance criteria
- An external MCP client can list+call our tools; our agents can call an external MCP tool.
## Verification
- Round-trip with an MCP client against our server; a fake external MCP tool call succeeds.
